description_en: Queries the monitoring data of a secondary elastic network interface (ENI) over a specific period of time
description_zh: 调用DescribeEniMonitorData查询一块辅助网卡在指定时间段内使用的流量信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-eni-monitor-data --eni-id eni-bp19da36d6xdwey0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp1a5zr3u7nq9cx0000 --start-time 2018-05-21T12:19:00Z --end-time 2018-05-21T12:22:00Z --period 60 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEniMonitorData

parameters.description_en: The secondary ENI ID. By default, all secondary ENIs that are bound to the specified instance are queried.
parameters.description_zh: 辅助网卡的ID。默认查询指定实例上所有已绑定的辅助网卡。
parameters.help_en: The secondary ENI ID. By default, all secondary ENIs that are bound to the specified instance are queried
parameters.help_zh: 辅助网卡的ID。默认查询指定实例上所有已绑定的辅助网卡
parameters.name: eni_id

parameters.description_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the instance to which the secondary ENI is bound.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the secondary ENI is bound
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is rounded up to the next minute.
parameters.description_zh: 获取数据的起始时间点。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（ss）不是00，则自动换算为下一分钟。
parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is rounded up to the next minute
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据的起始时间点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（ss）不是00，则自动换算为下一分钟。
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is rounded up to the next minute.
parameters.description_zh: 获取数据的结束时间点。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（ss）不是00，则自动换算为下一分钟。
parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is rounded up to the next minute
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据的结束时间点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（ss）不是00，则自动换算为下一分钟。
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description_en:
The interval at which to retrieve the monitoring data. Unit: seconds. Default value: Month. Valid values:

- 60

- 600

- 3600

Default: 60.
parameters.description_zh:
获取监控数据的间隔时间，单位：秒。取值范围：
- 60。
- 600。
- 3600。

默认值：60。
